scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Ask the customer to confirm their account information to ensure you're speaking with the correct person.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Use the customer's name and reference their specific issue to show you're addressing their unique concern.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Start the call with a genuine expression of understanding and apology for the inconvenience they're experiencing.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Repeat back what you've understood from the customer's issue to ensure you're on the right track and to show you're actively listening.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Use polite language and a friendly tone to create a welcoming atmosphere and establish trust with the customer.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask open-ended questions to gather more information about the issue and to clarify any unclear points.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly state that the issue has been resolved and ask the customer to confirm they're satisfied with the outcome.
